code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Locate the full-width divider and the non-background shape.
    div=next(r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0] not in (1,0))
    bg=g[0][0]
    color=next(c for row in g for c in row if c not in (bg,g[div][0]))
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color]
    minr=min(r for r,c in cells); maxr=max(r for r,c in cells)
    if maxr < div:
        # move shape to immediately above divider
        shift=(div-1)-maxr
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in cells: g[r+shift][c]=color
        trail= minr+shift-1
    elif minr > div:
        shift=(div+1)-minr
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in cells: g[r+shift][c]=color
        trail=maxr+shift+1
    else:
        return g
    if 0<=trail<h: g[trail]=[8]*w
    return g
'''
